paper_title: Let the Expert Stick to His Last Expert-Specialized Fine-Tuning for   Sparse Architectural Large Language Models
caption: Top Expert distribution for specific tasks. Shaded areas represent variance across layers. The figure shows that few experts handle most gate values, highlighting expert specialization for different tasks.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the normalized average gate value across different numbers of experts for various tasks, with shaded regions indicating variance across layers. The x-axis, labeled "Experts," is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 1 to 64, while the y-axis, labeled "Normalized Average Gate Value," ranges from 0.00 to 0.20. Each line represents a different task: Intent (orange), Summary (blue), Law (yellow), Translation (purple), Math (gray), and Code (green), with a dashed line representing the Uniform baseline. The lines generally decrease as the number of experts increases, with the Translation task showing the highest gate values at lower expert counts, while the other tasks exhibit similar trends, all converging toward the Uniform baseline as the number of experts grows. The shaded areas around each line highlight the variability in gate values across different layers of the model.
